user.title: Frickelalarm
user.description: Create an alarm area. You can add more areas later for separate partitions.

abort.already_configured: An area with this name already exists.

init.title: Frickelalarm settings
init.description: What would you like to configure?

actions.title: Reactions on alarm
actions.description: These actors are switched on when the alarm triggers and switched off again afterwards. Optionally a notification. In the text you can use {{ name }} (area), {{ reason }} (triggering sensor) and {{ event }}.

times.title: Delays & alarm duration
times.description: All values in seconds. 0 = no delay.

sensors.title: Select sensors
sensors.description: Pick the sensors (door/window contacts, motion detectors …) that belong to this alarm. A detail page follows for each one.

data.always: Always armed (even when disarmed, e.g. smoke/tamper)

bypass.name: Bypass sensors
bypass.description: Temporarily excludes one or more sensors (until the next disarm). "Always armed" sensors cannot be bypassed.

clear_bypass.name: Clear bypass
clear_bypass.description: Clears the bypass for specific sensors, or for all of them when left empty.

add_sensor.name: Add sensor
add_sensor.description: Adds a sensor to the alarm or updates it (same entity_id). For UI automations and LLM/MCP access.

modes.name: Modes
modes.description: Which modes the sensor is armed in (default: all).

remove_sensor.name: Remove sensor
remove_sensor.description: Removes a sensor from the alarm.

set_times.name: Set times
set_times.description: Sets exit/entry delay and alarm duration in seconds (only the values given).

entry_delay.name: Entry delay
entry_delay.description: Seconds to disarm before full alarm.

set_reactions.name: Set reactions
set_reactions.description: Sets the actors on alarm and the notification (only the values given).

sirens.name: Actors
sirens.description: Siren/light/switch to turn on during alarm and off afterwards.

get_config.name: Get configuration
get_config.description: Returns the current configuration of the area (sensors, times, reactions, state) – ideal for LLM/MCP access.
